title: MusMus electronic onomatopoeia pack
description: A set of 16: short pop and click electronic onomatopoeia (beeps, pops, a chime, and similar), yes/no judgments, a scissor snip, mechanical operation sounds, and attention tones. (Count: 16) [audio-standard] partial membership, 4 of 10 sounds (the standard flag on the local index.jsonl / source of truth: internal repo sfx-curation.json)
when_to_use: When you want a light UI sound, a yes/no judgment, a mechanical operation or switch, or a chime notification
